steps.code:
# Fetch all transactions from this year with direction='sent' and filter for electricity bills
access_token = login_result['access_token']
transactions = []
page_index = 0
page_limit = 20
while True:
    page = apis.venmo.show_transactions(
        access_token=access_token,
        min_created_at='2023-01-01',
        max_created_at='2023-05-18',
        direction='sent',
        page_index=page_index,
        page_limit=page_limit
    )
    if not page:
        break
    transactions.extend(page)
    if len(page) < page_limit:
        break
    page_index += 1

# Filter for electricity bill transactions
electricity = [t for t in transactions if 'electricity' in t['description'].lower()]
print(f"Found {len(electricity)} electricity transactions")
for t in electricity:
    print(t)
